text:
Yara: Quick copy review — the billing panel shows an inline overage warning: "You exceeded your plan. Contact sales." Feels blunt and unhelpful. Screenshot: https://redwood.screenshot/billing-overage.png
Tom: Agreed. Need clear next steps and a calming tone. Users panic at the word 'exceeded'.
Ivy: Suggest shorter, friendlier phrasing + one action. Examples:
- "Usage over plan — Upgrade or request extra credits"
- "Usage limit reached. Request more capacity"
Riley (eng): Implementation note: we only surface the inline when usage > 100% and there's no auto-topup. The button can open billing settings or start a credit request flow. Mobile space is small.
i18n-bot: Reminder: avoid contractions, keep action labels <=3 words, mark variable inserts (plan name) for translators.
Yara: Final proposal for mocks:
Main: "Usage limit reached — Request more capacity"
Action: "Request credits" (opens billing flow)
Alt short: "Usage limit reached"
Action short: "Open billing"
Ivy: LGTM. Tiny nit: test wrap on small screens, and make sure the aria-live announcement reads the action intent e.g., "Usage limit reached. Button: Request credits".
Tom: I'll update the figma and add copy keys for i18n. Thanks all :sparkles:
